image_description: A close-up shot of two lighters resting on a human hand. The primary subject is a tall, cylindrical lighter with an iridescent purple and blue metallic finish. Behind it sits a standard rectangular disposable lighter, pink in color with a black top mechanism. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blur of skin tones.
